svg.aria-label: Scan, Pipesmith Registry 0.2.1. scan reads the properties files of each store and replaces its rows at once; serve takes them over at its next request. 1: Operator to scan: pipesmith-registry scan [store]. 2: scan to Blob stores: every <id>.properties below content/. 3: scan: live, deleted, copies, no_bytes, unparsable: only live files count. 4: scan: a store that looks empty while the index holds rows is refused. 5: scan to index.sqlite: rows of the store replaced in one transaction. 6: scan to catalog.sqlite: the same entries. 7: scan to Operator: scan <store>: live=7 deleted=0 copies=0 .... Next request. 8: serve to index.sqlite: generation changed: take the new rows over. 9: serve: during a scan it answers from the last finished one.
svg.title: Pipesmith Registry scan
